arguments.command:
set -eu; W=/home/storage/781/4477781/user/webapp; DB=$W/openwebui-data/webui.db; echo '--- ollama env ---'; pid=$(ps -eo pid,args | awk '//781/4477781/user/webapp/miniconda/bin/ollama serve/{print $1; exit}'); if [ -n "${pid:-}" ] && [ -r /proc/$pid/environ ]; then tr '\0' '\n' < /proc/$pid/environ | grep -E '^(HOME|PATH|OLLAMA_[A-Z0-9_]+)=' | sort; fi; echo '--- openwebui env relevant ---'; pid=$(ps -eo pid,args | awk '//781/4477781/user/webapp/envs/openwebui/bin/open-webui serve/{print $1; exit}'); if [ -n "${pid:-}" ] && [ -r /proc/$pid/environ ]; then tr '\0' '\n' < /proc/$pid/environ | grep -E '^(DATA_DIR|HF_HOME|OLLAMA_[A-Z0-9_]+|OPENWEBUI_[A-Z0-9_]+|AIOHTTP_CLIENT_TIMEOUT)=' | sort; fi; echo '--- db schema ---'; $W/envs/openwebui/bin/python - "$DB" <<'PY'
import sqlite3,sys
p=sys.argv[1]
c=sqlite3.connect('file:'+p+'?mode=ro',uri=True)
for name,sql in c.execute("select name,sql from sqlite_master where type='table' order by name"):
    if name in ('config','model','function','tool','user','chat') or any(x in name.lower() for x in ('config','model','setting')):
        print(name, (sql or '')[:1000])
PY
